first.rationale: The concurrent onboarding-completion and activation declines make onboarding simplification the most directly relevant reversible experiment. Prior evidence indicates durable activation and time-to-value improvements, whereas promotional pricing has a known retention cost that conflicts with sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the onboarding flow for self-serve accounts. It directly addresses the 4% completion decline and 6% activation decline, with verified evidence of +13% completion, 2.1 fewer days to value, and +3% 30-day retention. This is more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than pricing, whose inherited evidence includes material retention harm. The result should still be evaluated by segment and with qualified-revenue and retention guardrails before any rollout.
